Google is taking another big step in making AI more useful for everyday users. Gemini Spark, Google’s proactive AI agent, is now rolling out to Google AI Pro subscribers in the United States, with plans to expand availability to AI Pro subscribers in more countries soon. Previously, Spark was primarily available to users on the higher-priced AI Ultra plan, making this rollout a significant milestone in bringing advanced AI capabilities to a wider audience.
From AI Assistant to AI Agent
For the past few years, AI assistants have mainly responded to prompts you ask a question, and they provide an answer. Gemini Spark introduces a different approach.
Instead of waiting for instructions every time, Spark is designed to work on your behalf. You can assign it a goal, and it continues working in the background, handling multi-step tasks even when you’re not actively using the Gemini app. This shift represents Google’s vision of moving from conversational AI to agentic AI.
What Can Gemini Spark Do?
Gemini Spark combines Google’s latest AI models with deep integration across Google’s ecosystem. It can connect with apps such as Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar…
